title: Debug the boundary
prompt: `total` crashes with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException on every call. Fix the loop bound — the smallest possible repair.

tests.name: no crash
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.total(new int[]{1, 2, 3}), 6, "sums without crash");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.total(new int[]{}), 0, "empty safe");
tests.hint: i <= arr.length runs one index too far; use i < arr.length.
